title: demo-intake: keep each response under 80 words
body:
## Summary
Responses written by demo-intake run long.

## Gap in current rules
`instructions/shared-writing.md` says: "Keep each reply under 80 words."

## Proposal
1. Under the condition that the first response exceeds 80 words, shorten it to the 80-word limit that the shared writing rules set.

## Acceptance criteria
1. A 120-word first response is cut to fewer than 80 words and keeps the team name.

title: demo-intake: add a glossary of queue terms
body:
## Summary
demo-intake uses queue terms inconsistently.

## Proposal
1. Create `instructions/glossary.md` with the queue terms that demo-intake uses, each with one definition.
2. Under the condition that demo-intake writes a term, use the glossary wording.

## Acceptance criteria
1. A first response that names the "hold queue" uses the glossary definition.

title: shared text: one glossary for every reply
body:
## Summary
Replies across the plugin name the same queue differently.

## Proposal
1. Create `instructions/glossary.md` with the terms that replies use.
2. The implementer decides whether the glossary applies to demo-intake only or to every shared text.

## Acceptance criteria
1. Two different replies that name the "hold queue" use the same word.

title: demo-intake: route by language
body:
## Summary
Items in other languages land in the wrong team.

## Proposal
1. Under the condition that an item is not in English, route it to the language team.
